limitations.consequence: M0.1 establishes only the exact connector-visible source-hosting state. It does not prove the absence of classic branch protection or establish repository Actions policy.
limitations.disposition: Retain administration-only controls as unverified. At both eligibility checkpoints, compare the candidate PR, branch heads, workflow blobs, visible settings, rulesets, and releases with the bound snapshot; retain the assessment, fail closed if assessment is unavailable, and reacquire with renewed binding if anything changed.
limitations.reason: Administration-only branch protection and Actions policy were inaccessible, while the exact candidate, pull request, migration branches, workflow blobs, visible repository metadata, rulesets, and releases were inspected. Administrative policy does not replace the independently bound C/E/D/P and sole-human-merge controls.

limitations.reason: Governance content identities were inspected, administration-only protection was inaccessible, and the observation deliberately binds rather than duplicates the charter bytes.

limitations.consequence: The M0.1 domain finding is limited to portfolio, public RDAP, and public DNS facts. It does not establish registrar-account control, TLS behavior, redirects, served content, or cutover readiness.

The M0.1 procedure inspected and recorded bounded package, tooling, store, social, and attempted trademark searches, including the unavailable USPTO result.
